test_enum_members: test pybind11 native enum members by asserting each enum type has the correct name and value pairs
test_pickle_roundtrip: test pickling and unpickling pybind11 native enum values to verify roundtrip serialization works correctly
test_enum_flag: test bitwise OR operations on pybind11 native enum flags and verify membership checks
test_pybind11_isinstance_color: test isinstance checks on pybind11 native enum instances to verify type discrimination works
test_native_enum_double_finalize: test that calling finalize twice on a pybind11 native enum raises the expected RuntimeError
